args.lesson: STOP_BOUNDED, 1 of 3 FETCHes used. What worked: reading the existing bid-readiness evidence first showed that the submission route (PCS-Tender) is behind registration, and that the OCDS document entries are only ids with no URLs, so there was no linked public document to fetch. That kept the test to one FETCH. What failed: the official FTS HTML notice returned HTTP 403 to our fetcher; I did not retry it or try a bypass. Next time: before creating a document-value mission, check whether OCDS documents carry URLs. If they do not and the portal requires registration, buyer-held pack facts cannot be reached without a supplier identity or excerpts that a provider pastes in. Do not open another fetch-based mission for this notice. Reconsider only if a public document URL appears or a real request supplies excerpts.
